metrics.description: Mean waiting time of visitors who started service (started-only; biased low under overload).
Mean wait including abandoned and still-waiting visitors (elapsed waits are lower bounds).
Median waiting time of visitors who started service.
Completed services in the observation window divided by its length in hours.
Busy counter-time divided by available counter-time in the observation window.
Time-weighted mean number of visitors waiting in the observation window.
Maximum number of visitors waiting in the observation window.
Abandoned visitors divided by eligible visitors who joined the queue (no-shows excluded).
Visitors turned away by the queue capacity divided by eligible visitors.
Share of determined visitors served within the service-level threshold (abandoned/blocked count as failures).
Share of determined visitors whose realised or elapsed wait exceeds the threshold.
Services completed inside the observation window.
Visitors arriving in the observation window who were not no-shows.
Largest realised or elapsed wait of any eligible visitor.

limitations: Results come from a stochastic simulation of the configured scenario; they describe that model, not a real service centre.
Distribution families, parameters, thresholds and constraint limits are the user's assumptions, not measured data.
Constraint status is evaluated after each run. The fairness-constrained policy uses online heuristics and makes no guarantee that an aggregate constraint holds.
Confidence intervals treat replications as independent and use a Student-t interval; they quantify simulation noise only, not model error.
Waiting-time metrics over started visitors are biased low when many visitors are still waiting at the horizon; see the censoring-inclusive metrics and warnings.
